original_context: Titan does not thrive in water.
Titan does not have iridescent fur.
Titan does not have luminous scales.
Titan does not protect its habitat.
For all mythical creatures, if they are either aquatic or inhabit the depths, then they thrive in water.
If Titan is aquatic, then it either has wings or has iridescent fur, but not both.
If Titan has wings, then it either has luminous scales or possesses a majestic appearance, but not both.
Any mythical creature with a majestic appearance inspires awe.
If Titan wields authority, then it will protect its habitat.
Titan either commands respect or inspires awe, but not both.
If Titan possesses magic or controls the elements, then it can wield authority.
If Titan can shape the oceans themselves, then it either controls the elements or commands respect, but not both.
If Titan possesses great power, then it can shape the oceans themselves.
conclusion: Titan does not possess great power.
